top_signals.title: Bond Vigilantes Are Coming Back: Peter Orszag
top_signals.summary: Peter Orszag, chairman and CEO of Lazard joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss AI, retirement reform, Trump Accounts, and the next generation of investment bankers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
